name: Run an administrative operation
description: Executes one operator operation with the venue's authority. Odin only. Without `user`: one of the venue operations — v/ops/venue/adapters, v/ops/venue/adapter/enable|disable|configure, v/ops/venue/module/load|unload, v/ops/user/create|list|info, v/ops/ucan/issue (for venue-controlled resources). With `user`: runs the operation inside that user's namespace on their behalf (user:sudo, this venue's own users only) — one of v/ops/covia/read|list|inspect|write|delete, v/ops/agent/list|info|update|resume|sessions|delete-session|delete, v/ops/skills/list|read. Anything else is refused. Every run is a recorded job.

operation.description: The full operation path, e.g. v/ops/venue/adapter/enable.

input.description: The operation's own input, exactly as its schema describes.

user.description: Optional: a user DID of this venue. When present the operation runs inside that user's namespace on their behalf, and must be one of the namespace operations.
